productArea.name: Issues
productArea.scope: Search, filter, sort, and manage issues across global, organization, and repository lists, including creation, editing, assignments, comments, dependencies, bulk actions, and issue tracker configuration. Label, milestone, and project selection is included, but managing those resources, pull requests, and other repository settings is outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Issues in the global navigation and use the inventory filters.
Choose Issues in the seeded repository, then create or open an issue for its discussion, sidebar, and dependencies.
Choose Settings then Units Overview and inspect only the issue tracker controls.
Choose an organization you can access, then its Issues dashboard and team filters. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
